title: He Turned Rain Into Money
sources: Original fictional story (Marble Street series). Marlo, MegaSock and every event are invented; no real-world facts are claimed.

lines.text: Every time it rained on Marble Street,
because he never remembered his umbrella.
Then one stormy morning, he saw twenty people
stuck under the bakery roof, just like him.
So Marlo bought a barrel of cheap umbrellas,
put it by the bus stop,
borrow one for a dollar, return it at any shop.
By lunch, the barrel was empty.
and every umbrella flipped inside out.
So he switched to tough ones that bend but never break.
Then MegaSock rolled in a giant umbrella machine,
But every time you return one of Marlo's,
the bakery gives you a free cookie.
So now, Marble Street actually hopes it rains.
